description: This file defines the Article model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and managing articles, their comments, ratings, and layout information within the catalog module. The class interacts extensively with the database for CRUD operations related to articles and their associated comments and metadata.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: A model class for managing articles in the OpenCart catalog, including fetching articles, comments, ratings, and layout information.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific article identified by its ID.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on filter criteria, with support for sorting, pagination, and search filters.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles matching provided filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout ID associated with a particular article.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a new comment to an article and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific article.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific comment on an article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments associated with an article, supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total number of comments for a specific article based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total number of comments associated with a specific article, filtered by optional criteria such as customer ID and parent comment ID.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Inserts a new rating record for a specific comment on an article, including details such as store ID, customer ID, rating value, IP address, and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteRatings
methods.description: Removes rating records for a specific comment on an article associated with the current customer.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating counts grouped by rating value for a given article and optional comment ID, to analyze distribution of ratings.
